item.title: Mining Engineer at Sample Mining Limited
item.content:encoded:
Closing date: 15 December 2026

Location: Solwezi City

Job type: Full time

Qualification: Bachelor of Science in Mining Engineering

Experience: five (5) years

The mining engineer will plan and supervise underground and open pit operations, manage blasting schedules, monitor ventilation and ground conditions, and prepare production reports for the mine manager. The successful candidate must hold a recognised engineering degree, understand safety regulations, lead shift teams and work closely with geologists and surveyors. Experience with mine planning software and cost control is an advantage for this position at the Solwezi operation.

item.title: Cook at Beta Foods
item.content:encoded:
Closing date: 20 December 2026

Location: Lusaka City

Job type: Permanent and pensionable

The cook prepares breakfast and lunch for sixty staff, orders groceries each week, keeps the kitchen clean and safe, follows hygiene rules and records the temperature of the cold room twice a day. Applicants must hold a food handling certificate and be able to work early shifts and some weekends.
